import FormalConjecturesUtil

/-!
# Conjecture 9.55

by K. W. Roggenkamp

Does there exist a finite $p$-group $G$ and a central augmented automorphism $\varphi$ of
$\mathbb{Z}G$ such that $\varphi$, if extended to $\widehat{\mathbb{Z}}_pG$, the $p$-adic group
ring, is *not* conjugation by a unit in $\widehat{\mathbb{Z}}_pG$ followed by a homomorphism
induced from a group automorphism?

Here an automorphism $\varphi$ of the integral group ring $\mathbb{Z}G$ is *augmented* if it
commutes with the augmentation map $\varepsilon : \mathbb{Z}G \to \mathbb{Z}$,
$\sum_g a_g g \mapsto \sum_g a_g$, and *central* if it fixes the centre of $\mathbb{Z}G$
elementwise (equivalently, it fixes every class sum). The $p$-adic group ring
$\widehat{\mathbb{Z}}_pG$ is $\mathbb{Z}_p G$, where $\mathbb{Z}_p$ is the ring of $p$-adic
integers. Since $\mathbb{Z}_p G = \mathbb{Z}_p \otimes_{\mathbb{Z}} \mathbb{Z}G$, the
automorphism $\varphi$ extends uniquely to a $\mathbb{Z}_p$-algebra automorphism
$\widehat{\varphi}$ of $\mathbb{Z}_p G$.

*Reference:* [The Kourovka Notebook](https://arxiv.org/abs/1401.0300v46)
-/
namespace Kourovka.«9.55»
open MonoidAlgebra
variable {G : Type*} [Group G]

blocks.code:
noncomputable def augmentation (R : Type*) [CommRing R] : MonoidAlgebra R G →ₐ[R] R :=
  lift R R G 1
blocks.docstring:
The augmentation map $\varepsilon : RG \to R$, $\sum_g a_g g \mapsto \sum_g a_g$, of the
group ring $RG$.

justification.closest_existing_considered: MonoidAlgebra.lift / MonoidAlgebra.liftNC (used to build it); no dedicated augmentation exists.
justification.name: Kourovka.«9.55».augmentation
justification.why_needed: Mathlib has no augmentation map R[G] → R for monoid algebras (rg 'augmentation' finds only matroid/simplicial uses). Defined as MonoidAlgebra.lift R R G 1 (the trivial monoid hom), with proven API lemma augmentation_single : augmentation R (single g r) = r.

blocks.name: augmentation
blocks.text:
/-- The augmentation map $\varepsilon : RG \to R$, $\sum_g a_g g \mapsto \sum_g a_g$, of the
group ring $RG$. -/
noncomputable def augmentation (R : Type*) [CommRing R] : MonoidAlgebra R G →ₐ[R] R :=
  lift R R G 1

blocks.code:
@[category API, AMS 16 20]
theorem augmentation_single (R : Type*) [CommRing R] (g : G) (r : R) :
    augmentation R (single g r) = r := by
  simp [augmentation]
blocks.name: augmentation_single
blocks.text:
/-- The augmentation of $r g$ is $r$. -/
@[category API, AMS 16 20]
theorem augmentation_single (R : Type*) [CommRing R] (g : G) (r : R) :
    augmentation R (single g r) = r := by
  simp [augmentation]

blocks.code:
def IsAugmented (φ : MonoidAlgebra ℤ G ≃+* MonoidAlgebra ℤ G) : Prop :=
  ∀ x, augmentation ℤ (φ x) = augmentation ℤ x
blocks.docstring:
A ring automorphism $\varphi$ of $\mathbb{Z}G$ is *augmented* if it commutes with the
augmentation map, i.e. $\varepsilon \circ \varphi = \varepsilon$.

justification.name: Kourovka.«9.55».IsAugmented
justification.why_needed: Predicate 'ring automorphism φ of ℤ[G] commutes with the augmentation', ∀ x, ε (φ x) = ε x.

blocks.name: IsAugmented
blocks.text:
/-- A ring automorphism $\varphi$ of $\mathbb{Z}G$ is *augmented* if it commutes with the
augmentation map, i.e. $\varepsilon \circ \varphi = \varepsilon$. -/
def IsAugmented (φ : MonoidAlgebra ℤ G ≃+* MonoidAlgebra ℤ G) : Prop :=
  ∀ x, augmentation ℤ (φ x) = augmentation ℤ x

blocks.code:
def IsCentral (φ : MonoidAlgebra ℤ G ≃+* MonoidAlgebra ℤ G) : Prop :=
  ∀ z ∈ Subring.center (MonoidAlgebra ℤ G), φ z = z
blocks.docstring:
A ring automorphism $\varphi$ of $\mathbb{Z}G$ is *central* if it fixes the centre
$Z(\mathbb{Z}G)$ elementwise.

justification.closest_existing_considered: Subring.center (used); no notion of 'central automorphism' of a ring exists in Mathlib.
justification.name: Kourovka.«9.55».IsCentral
justification.why_needed: Predicate 'φ fixes the centre Z(ℤG) elementwise': ∀ z ∈ Subring.center (MonoidAlgebra ℤ G), φ z = z. This is Roggenkamp's notion of a central automorphism of a group ring (equivalent to fixing all class sums, which form a ℤ-basis of the centre).

blocks.name: IsCentral
blocks.text:
/-- A ring automorphism $\varphi$ of $\mathbb{Z}G$ is *central* if it fixes the centre
$Z(\mathbb{Z}G)$ elementwise. -/
def IsCentral (φ : MonoidAlgebra ℤ G ≃+* MonoidAlgebra ℤ G) : Prop :=
  ∀ z ∈ Subring.center (MonoidAlgebra ℤ G), φ z = z

@[category API, AMS 16 20]
theorem isAugmented_domCongr (σ : G ≃* G) : IsAugmented (domCongr ℤ ℤ σ).toRingEquiv := by
  intro x
  have : (augmentation ℤ).comp (domCongr ℤ ℤ σ).toAlgHom = augmentation ℤ := by
    apply algHom_ext
    intro g
    simp [augmentation]
  exact AlgHom.congr_fun this x

blocks.code:
noncomputable def toPadic (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] :
    MonoidAlgebra ℤ G →+* MonoidAlgebra ℤ_[p] G :=
  mapRangeRingHom G (Int.castRingHom ℤ_[p])
blocks.docstring:
The canonical embedding $\mathbb{Z}G \to \mathbb{Z}_pG$ of the integral group ring into the
$p$-adic group ring, induced by $\mathbb{Z} \to \mathbb{Z}_p$ on coefficients.

justification.name: Kourovka.«9.55».toPadic
justification.why_needed: The coefficient embedding ℤ[G] →+* ℤ_[p][G]; just MonoidAlgebra.mapRangeRingHom G (Int.castRingHom ℤ_[p]) given a name for readability.

blocks.name: toPadic
blocks.text:
/-- The canonical embedding $\mathbb{Z}G \to \mathbb{Z}_pG$ of the integral group ring into the
$p$-adic group ring, induced by $\mathbb{Z} \to \mathbb{Z}_p$ on coefficients. -/
noncomputable def toPadic (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] :
    MonoidAlgebra ℤ G →+* MonoidAlgebra ℤ_[p] G :=
  mapRangeRingHom G (Int.castRingHom ℤ_[p])

blocks.code:
noncomputable def padicExtension (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    (φ : MonoidAlgebra ℤ G ≃+* MonoidAlgebra ℤ G) :
    MonoidAlgebra ℤ_[p] G →ₐ[ℤ_[p]] MonoidAlgebra ℤ_[p] G :=
  lift ℤ_[p] (MonoidAlgebra ℤ_[p] G) G
    ((toPadic p).toMonoidHom.comp (φ.toRingHom.toMonoidHom.comp (of ℤ G)))
blocks.docstring:
The unique $\mathbb{Z}_p$-linear extension $\widehat{\varphi}$ of a ring automorphism
$\varphi$ of $\mathbb{Z}G$ to the $p$-adic group ring $\mathbb{Z}_pG$: it sends $g \in G$ to the
image of $\varphi(g)$ in $\mathbb{Z}_pG$ and is extended $\mathbb{Z}_p$-linearly.

justification.closest_existing_considered: MonoidAlgebra.mapRangeAlgHom / mapRangeAlgEquiv (wrong shape: they change coefficients, not lift an endomorphism); Algebra.TensorProduct.map (far heavier and would need ℤ_[p] ⊗[ℤ] ℤ[G] ≃ ℤ_[p][G]).
justification.name: Kourovka.«9.55».padicExtension
justification.why_needed: The ℤ_[p]-linear extension of φ to ℤ_[p][G], built with MonoidAlgebra.lift from the monoid hom g ↦ toPadic (φ g). Mathlib has no base-change of an arbitrary ring endomorphism of a monoid algebra (mapRangeAlgHom only handles maps of coefficient rings, mapDomain only maps of the monoid). The proven API lemma padicExtension_toPadic (padicExtension p φ (toPadic p x) = toPadic p (φ x)) certifies it is the extension; uniqueness follows because ℤ[G] spans ℤ_[p][G] over ℤ_[p].

blocks.name: padicExtension
blocks.text:
/-- The unique $\mathbb{Z}_p$-linear extension $\widehat{\varphi}$ of a ring automorphism
$\varphi$ of $\mathbb{Z}G$ to the $p$-adic group ring $\mathbb{Z}_pG$: it sends $g \in G$ to the
image of $\varphi(g)$ in $\mathbb{Z}_pG$ and is extended $\mathbb{Z}_p$-linearly. -/
noncomputable def padicExtension (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    (φ : MonoidAlgebra ℤ G ≃+* MonoidAlgebra ℤ G) :
    MonoidAlgebra ℤ_[p] G →ₐ[ℤ_[p]] MonoidAlgebra ℤ_[p] G :=
  lift ℤ_[p] (MonoidAlgebra ℤ_[p] G) G
    ((toPadic p).toMonoidHom.comp (φ.toRingHom.toMonoidHom.comp (of ℤ G)))

blocks.code:
@[category API, AMS 16 20]
theorem padicExtension_toPadic (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    (φ : MonoidAlgebra ℤ G ≃+* MonoidAlgebra ℤ G) (x : MonoidAlgebra ℤ G) :
    padicExtension p φ (toPadic p x) = toPadic p (φ x) := by
  have : (padicExtension p φ).toRingHom.comp (toPadic p) = (toPadic p).comp φ.toRingHom := by
    apply ringHom_ext
    · intro r
      have hr : single (1 : G) r = (r : MonoidAlgebra ℤ G) := by simp [intCast_def]
      simp [hr]
    · intro g
      simp only [RingHom.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply, AlgHom.toRingHom_eq_coe, RingHom.coe_coe]
      rw [← of_apply, padicExtension]
      simp only [toPadic, mapRangeRingHom_single, of_apply, map_one]
      rw [← of_apply, lift_of]
      simp
  exact RingHom.congr_fun this x
blocks.name: padicExtension_toPadic
blocks.text:
/-- The $p$-adic extension $\widehat{\varphi}$ agrees with $\varphi$ on $\mathbb{Z}G$. -/
@[category API, AMS 16 20]
theorem padicExtension_toPadic (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    (φ : MonoidAlgebra ℤ G ≃+* MonoidAlgebra ℤ G) (x : MonoidAlgebra ℤ G) :
    padicExtension p φ (toPadic p x) = toPadic p (φ x) := by
  have : (padicExtension p φ).toRingHom.comp (toPadic p) = (toPadic p).comp φ.toRingHom := by
    apply ringHom_ext
    · intro r
      have hr : single (1 : G) r = (r : MonoidAlgebra ℤ G) := by simp [intCast_def]
      simp [hr]
    · intro g
      simp only [RingHom.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply, AlgHom.toRingHom_eq_coe, RingHom.coe_coe]
      rw [← of_apply, padicExtension]
      simp only [toPadic, mapRangeRingHom_single, of_apply, map_one]
      rw [← of_apply, lift_of]
      simp
  exact RingHom.congr_fun this x

blocks.code:
@[category API, AMS 16 20]
theorem eq_padicExtension (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    (φ : MonoidAlgebra ℤ G ≃+* MonoidAlgebra ℤ G)
    (ψ : MonoidAlgebra ℤ_[p] G →ₐ[ℤ_[p]] MonoidAlgebra ℤ_[p] G)
    (hψ : ∀ x, ψ (toPadic p x) = toPadic p (φ x)) :
    ψ = padicExtension p φ := by
  refine algHom_ext fun g => ?_
  have h := hψ (single g 1)
  simp only [toPadic, mapRangeRingHom_single, map_one] at h
  rw [h]
  simp [padicExtension, toPadic]
blocks.docstring:
The $p$-adic extension $\widehat{\varphi}$ is the unique $\mathbb{Z}_p$-algebra
endomorphism of $\mathbb{Z}_pG$ agreeing with $\varphi$ on $\mathbb{Z}G$.
blocks.name: eq_padicExtension
blocks.text:
/-- The $p$-adic extension $\widehat{\varphi}$ is the unique $\mathbb{Z}_p$-algebra
endomorphism of $\mathbb{Z}_pG$ agreeing with $\varphi$ on $\mathbb{Z}G$. -/
@[category API, AMS 16 20]
theorem eq_padicExtension (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    (φ : MonoidAlgebra ℤ G ≃+* MonoidAlgebra ℤ G)
    (ψ : MonoidAlgebra ℤ_[p] G →ₐ[ℤ_[p]] MonoidAlgebra ℤ_[p] G)
    (hψ : ∀ x, ψ (toPadic p x) = toPadic p (φ x)) :
    ψ = padicExtension p φ := by
  refine algHom_ext fun g => ?_
  have h := hψ (single g 1)
  simp only [toPadic, mapRangeRingHom_single, map_one] at h
  rw [h]
  simp [padicExtension, toPadic]

blocks.code:
def IsConjThenGroupInduced (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    (ψ : MonoidAlgebra ℤ_[p] G →ₐ[ℤ_[p]] MonoidAlgebra ℤ_[p] G) : Prop :=
  ∃ (u : (MonoidAlgebra ℤ_[p] G)ˣ) (σ : G ≃* G),
    ∀ x, ψ x = domCongr ℤ_[p] ℤ_[p] σ (u * x * u⁻¹)
blocks.docstring:
A $\mathbb{Z}_p$-algebra endomorphism $\psi$ of $\mathbb{Z}_pG$ is *conjugation by a unit
followed by a homomorphism induced from a group automorphism* if there are a unit
$u \in (\mathbb{Z}_pG)^\times$ and a group automorphism $\sigma \in \mathrm{Aut}(G)$ such that
$\psi(x) = \hat\sigma(u x u^{-1})$ for all $x \in \mathbb{Z}_pG$, where
$\hat\sigma$ is the $\mathbb{Z}_p$-algebra automorphism of $\mathbb{Z}_pG$ induced by
$\sigma$.

justification.closest_existing_considered: MulAut.conj (gives a MulAut, not a ring/algebra hom, and is not composable with domCongr as needed); MonoidAlgebra.domCongr and Units are used directly.
justification.name: Kourovka.«9.55».IsConjThenGroupInduced
justification.why_needed: Predicate 'ψ is conjugation by a unit u ∈ (ℤ_[p][G])ˣ followed by the automorphism induced by some σ ∈ Aut G': ∃ u σ, ∀ x, ψ x = domCongr ℤ_[p] ℤ_[p] σ (u * x * u⁻¹). A proven test lemma checks the identity satisfies it (u = 1, σ = refl).

blocks.name: IsConjThenGroupInduced
blocks.text:
/-- A $\mathbb{Z}_p$-algebra endomorphism $\psi$ of $\mathbb{Z}_pG$ is *conjugation by a unit
followed by a homomorphism induced from a group automorphism* if there are a unit
$u \in (\mathbb{Z}_pG)^\times$ and a group automorphism $\sigma \in \mathrm{Aut}(G)$ such that
$\psi(x) = \hat\sigma(u x u^{-1})$ for all $x \in \mathbb{Z}_pG$, where
$\hat\sigma$ is the $\mathbb{Z}_p$-algebra automorphism of $\mathbb{Z}_pG$ induced by
$\sigma$. -/
def IsConjThenGroupInduced (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    (ψ : MonoidAlgebra ℤ_[p] G →ₐ[ℤ_[p]] MonoidAlgebra ℤ_[p] G) : Prop :=
  ∃ (u : (MonoidAlgebra ℤ_[p] G)ˣ) (σ : G ≃* G),
    ∀ x, ψ x = domCongr ℤ_[p] ℤ_[p] σ (u * x * u⁻¹)

blocks.code:
@[category test, AMS 16 20]
theorem isConjThenGroupInduced_id (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] :
    IsConjThenGroupInduced p (AlgHom.id ℤ_[p] (MonoidAlgebra ℤ_[p] G)) :=
  ⟨1, MulEquiv.refl G, fun x => by simp⟩
blocks.docstring:
The identity of $\mathbb{Z}_pG$ is conjugation by the unit $1$ followed by the automorphism
induced by the identity of $G$.
blocks.name: isConjThenGroupInduced_id
blocks.text:

induced by the identity of $G$. -/
@[category test, AMS 16 20]
theorem isConjThenGroupInduced_id (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] :
    IsConjThenGroupInduced p (AlgHom.id ℤ_[p] (MonoidAlgebra ℤ_[p] G)) :=
  ⟨1, MulEquiv.refl G, fun x => by simp⟩

@[category research open, AMS 16 20]
theorem kourovka.«9.55» : answer(sorry) ↔
    ∃ (p : ℕ) (_ : Fact p.Prime) (G : Type) (_ : Group G) (_ : Finite G), IsPGroup p G ∧
      ∃ φ : MonoidAlgebra ℤ G ≃+* MonoidAlgebra ℤ G,
        IsAugmented φ ∧ IsCentral φ ∧ ¬ IsConjThenGroupInduced p (padicExtension p φ) := by
  sorry
blocks.docstring:
Does there exist a finite $p$-group $G$ and a central augmented automorphism $\varphi$ of
$\mathbb{Z}G$ such that $\varphi$, if extended to $\widehat{\mathbb{Z}}_pG$, the $p$-adic group
ring, is *not* conjugation by a unit in $\widehat{\mathbb{Z}}_pG$ followed by a homomorphism
induced from a group automorphism?

That is, is there a prime $p$, a finite $p$-group $G$ and a ring automorphism $\varphi$ of
$\mathbb{Z}G$ with $\varepsilon \circ \varphi = \varepsilon$ and $\varphi(z) = z$ for all
$z \in Z(\mathbb{Z}G)$, such that there are no unit $u \in (\mathbb{Z}_pG)^\times$ and
$\sigma \in \mathrm{Aut}(G)$ with $\widehat{\varphi}(x) = \hat\sigma(u x u^{-1})$ for all
$x \in \mathbb{Z}_pG$? The order of the two operations is immaterial, since $\hat\sigma$
permutes the units of $\mathbb{Z}_pG$.

claims.decomposer_note: Single yes/no existence Prop (answer(sorry) ↔ ∃ p prime, ∃ finite p-group G, ∃ ring automorphism φ of ℤ[G] that is augmented (commutes with the augmentation ℤ[G] → ℤ) and central (fixes the center of ℤ[G] pointwise, i.e. acts trivially on class sums), such that the unique ℤ_p-linear extension of φ to ℤ_p[G] is not of the form (conjugation by a unit u ∈ ℤ_p[G]) ∘ (automorphism induced by some σ ∈ Aut G)); subtleties: the composition order is immaterial since group automorphisms permute units, so the set of 'inner ∘ group-induced' automorphisms is the same either way; the quantifier over p is implicit; and the conjugating unit must lie in ℤ_p[G] itself, not merely in ℚ_p[G], which distinguishes this from the weaker Zassenhaus-type statement (Roggenkamp–Scott results on p-adic group rings of p-groups are relevant background but the notebook still lists the problem as open, so no answer should be baked in).
claims.reviewer_why: All eight candidates are faithful on every essential point (ring automorphism of ℤ[G]; augmented = ε∘φ = ε; central = fixes Subring/Set.center pointwise; ℤ_[p]-linear extension to MonoidAlgebra ℤ_[p] G; excluded form x ↦ σ̂(u x u⁻¹) or u σ̂(x) u⁻¹ with u a unit of ℤ_[p][G] itself and σ : G ≃* G; p existentially quantified with Fact p.Prime; Finite G ∧ IsPGroup p G; answer(sorry) outermost; no vacuity since the trivial group has only the identity automorphism, which is of the excluded form). c04 was chosen as the base because it has the clearest structure: named predicates IsAugmented / IsCentral / IsConjThenGroupInduced, an explicit padicExtension with a proven agreement lemma, and API/test lemmas carrying AMS tags (c01 lacks AMS tags on its API/test lemmas). I added c03's uniqueness lemma eq_padicExtension (certifying that padicExtension is *the* ℤ_p-linear extension), c01's trivial tests isAugmented_refl / isCentral_refl / isAugmented_domCongr, and an expanded theorem docstring. c02/c05/c06/c08 are also faithful but inline everything (c02/c06/c08 quantify the extension as ∃ Φ : AlgEquiv with a compatibility condition, which is fine since Φ exists and is unique).

import FormalConjecturesUtil

/-!
# Conjecture 9.55

by K. W. Roggenkamp

Does there exist a finite $p$-group $G$ and a central augmented automorphism $\varphi$ of
$\mathbb{Z}G$ such that $\varphi$, if extended to $\widehat{\mathbb{Z}}_pG$, the $p$-adic group
ring, is *not* conjugation by a unit in $\widehat{\mathbb{Z}}_pG$ followed by a homomorphism
induced from a group automorphism?

Here an automorphism $\varphi$ of the integral group ring $\mathbb{Z}G$ is *augmented* if it
commutes with the augmentation map $\varepsilon : \mathbb{Z}G \to \mathbb{Z}$,
$\sum_g a_g g \mapsto \sum_g a_g$, and *central* if it fixes the centre of $\mathbb{Z}G$
elementwise (equivalently, it fixes every class sum). The $p$-adic group ring
$\widehat{\mathbb{Z}}_pG$ is $\mathbb{Z}_p G$, where $\mathbb{Z}_p$ is the ring of $p$-adic
integers. Since $\mathbb{Z}_p G = \mathbb{Z}_p \otimes_{\mathbb{Z}} \mathbb{Z}G$, the
automorphism $\varphi$ extends uniquely to a $\mathbb{Z}_p$-algebra automorphism
$\widehat{\varphi}$ of $\mathbb{Z}_p G$.

*Reference:* [The Kourovka Notebook](https://arxiv.org/abs/1401.0300v46)
-/

namespace Kourovka.«9.55»

open MonoidAlgebra

variable {G : Type*} [Group G]

/-- The augmentation map $\varepsilon : RG \to R$, $\sum_g a_g g \mapsto \sum_g a_g$, of the
group ring $RG$. -/
noncomputable def augmentation (R : Type*) [CommRing R] : MonoidAlgebra R G →ₐ[R] R :=
  lift R R G 1

/-- The augmentation of $r g$ is $r$. -/
@[category API, AMS 16 20]
theorem augmentation_single (R : Type*) [CommRing R] (g : G) (r : R) :
    augmentation R (single g r) = r := by
  simp [augmentation]

/-- A ring automorphism $\varphi$ of $\mathbb{Z}G$ is *augmented* if it commutes with the
augmentation map, i.e. $\varepsilon \circ \varphi = \varepsilon$. -/
def IsAugmented (φ : MonoidAlgebra ℤ G ≃+* MonoidAlgebra ℤ G) : Prop :=
  ∀ x, augmentation ℤ (φ x) = augmentation ℤ x

/-- A ring automorphism $\varphi$ of $\mathbb{Z}G$ is *central* if it fixes the centre
$Z(\mathbb{Z}G)$ elementwise. -/
def IsCentral (φ : MonoidAlgebra ℤ G ≃+* MonoidAlgebra ℤ G) : Prop :=
  ∀ z ∈ Subring.center (MonoidAlgebra ℤ G), φ z = z

/-- The identity of $\mathbb{Z}G$ is augmented. -/
@[category test, AMS 16 20]
theorem isAugmented_refl : IsAugmented (RingEquiv.refl (MonoidAlgebra ℤ G)) := fun _ => rfl

/-- The identity of $\mathbb{Z}G$ is central. -/
@[category test, AMS 16 20]
theorem isCentral_refl : IsCentral (RingEquiv.refl (MonoidAlgebra ℤ G)) := fun _ _ => rfl

/-- The automorphism of $\mathbb{Z}G$ induced by a group automorphism is augmented. -/
@[category API, AMS 16 20]
theorem isAugmented_domCongr (σ : G ≃* G) : IsAugmented (domCongr ℤ ℤ σ).toRingEquiv := by
  intro x
  have : (augmentation ℤ).comp (domCongr ℤ ℤ σ).toAlgHom = augmentation ℤ := by
    apply algHom_ext
    intro g
    simp [augmentation]
  exact AlgHom.congr_fun this x

/-- The canonical embedding $\mathbb{Z}G \to \mathbb{Z}_pG$ of the integral group ring into the
$p$-adic group ring, induced by $\mathbb{Z} \to \mathbb{Z}_p$ on coefficients. -/
noncomputable def toPadic (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] :
    MonoidAlgebra ℤ G →+* MonoidAlgebra ℤ_[p] G :=
  mapRangeRingHom G (Int.castRingHom ℤ_[p])

/-- The unique $\mathbb{Z}_p$-linear extension $\widehat{\varphi}$ of a ring automorphism
$\varphi$ of $\mathbb{Z}G$ to the $p$-adic group ring $\mathbb{Z}_pG$: it sends $g \in G$ to the
image of $\varphi(g)$ in $\mathbb{Z}_pG$ and is extended $\mathbb{Z}_p$-linearly. -/
noncomputable def padicExtension (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    (φ : MonoidAlgebra ℤ G ≃+* MonoidAlgebra ℤ G) :
    MonoidAlgebra ℤ_[p] G →ₐ[ℤ_[p]] MonoidAlgebra ℤ_[p] G :=
  lift ℤ_[p] (MonoidAlgebra ℤ_[p] G) G
    ((toPadic p).toMonoidHom.comp (φ.toRingHom.toMonoidHom.comp (of ℤ G)))

/-- The $p$-adic extension $\widehat{\varphi}$ agrees with $\varphi$ on $\mathbb{Z}G$. -/
@[category API, AMS 16 20]
theorem padicExtension_toPadic (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    (φ : MonoidAlgebra ℤ G ≃+* MonoidAlgebra ℤ G) (x : MonoidAlgebra ℤ G) :
    padicExtension p φ (toPadic p x) = toPadic p (φ x) := by
  have : (padicExtension p φ).toRingHom.comp (toPadic p) = (toPadic p).comp φ.toRingHom := by
    apply ringHom_ext
    · intro r
      have hr : single (1 : G) r = (r : MonoidAlgebra ℤ G) := by simp [intCast_def]
      simp [hr]
    · intro g
      simp only [RingHom.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply, AlgHom.toRingHom_eq_coe, RingHom.coe_coe]
      rw [← of_apply, padicExtension]
      simp only [toPadic, mapRangeRingHom_single, of_apply, map_one]
      rw [← of_apply, lift_of]
      simp
  exact RingHom.congr_fun this x

/-- The $p$-adic extension $\widehat{\varphi}$ is the unique $\mathbb{Z}_p$-algebra
endomorphism of $\mathbb{Z}_pG$ agreeing with $\varphi$ on $\mathbb{Z}G$. -/
@[category API, AMS 16 20]
theorem eq_padicExtension (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    (φ : MonoidAlgebra ℤ G ≃+* MonoidAlgebra ℤ G)
    (ψ : MonoidAlgebra ℤ_[p] G →ₐ[ℤ_[p]] MonoidAlgebra ℤ_[p] G)
    (hψ : ∀ x, ψ (toPadic p x) = toPadic p (φ x)) :
    ψ = padicExtension p φ := by
  refine algHom_ext fun g => ?_
  have h := hψ (single g 1)
  simp only [toPadic, mapRangeRingHom_single, map_one] at h
  rw [h]
  simp [padicExtension, toPadic]

/-- A $\mathbb{Z}_p$-algebra endomorphism $\psi$ of $\mathbb{Z}_pG$ is *conjugation by a unit
followed by a homomorphism induced from a group automorphism* if there are a unit
$u \in (\mathbb{Z}_pG)^\times$ and a group automorphism $\sigma \in \mathrm{Aut}(G)$ such that
$\psi(x) = \hat\sigma(u x u^{-1})$ for all $x \in \mathbb{Z}_pG$, where
$\hat\sigma$ is the $\mathbb{Z}_p$-algebra automorphism of $\mathbb{Z}_pG$ induced by
$\sigma$. -/
def IsConjThenGroupInduced (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    (ψ : MonoidAlgebra ℤ_[p] G →ₐ[ℤ_[p]] MonoidAlgebra ℤ_[p] G) : Prop :=
  ∃ (u : (MonoidAlgebra ℤ_[p] G)ˣ) (σ : G ≃* G),
    ∀ x, ψ x = domCongr ℤ_[p] ℤ_[p] σ (u * x * u⁻¹)

/-- The identity of $\mathbb{Z}_pG$ is conjugation by the unit $1$ followed by the automorphism
induced by the identity of $G$. -/
@[category test, AMS 16 20]
theorem isConjThenGroupInduced_id (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] :
    IsConjThenGroupInduced p (AlgHom.id ℤ_[p] (MonoidAlgebra ℤ_[p] G)) :=
  ⟨1, MulEquiv.refl G, fun x => by simp⟩

/--
Does there exist a finite $p$-group $G$ and a central augmented automorphism $\varphi$ of
$\mathbb{Z}G$ such that $\varphi$, if extended to $\widehat{\mathbb{Z}}_pG$, the $p$-adic group
ring, is *not* conjugation by a unit in $\widehat{\mathbb{Z}}_pG$ followed by a homomorphism
induced from a group automorphism?

That is, is there a prime $p$, a finite $p$-group $G$ and a ring automorphism $\varphi$ of
$\mathbb{Z}G$ with $\varepsilon \circ \varphi = \varepsilon$ and $\varphi(z) = z$ for all
$z \in Z(\mathbb{Z}G)$, such that there are no unit $u \in (\mathbb{Z}_pG)^\times$ and
$\sigma \in \mathrm{Aut}(G)$ with $\widehat{\varphi}(x) = \hat\sigma(u x u^{-1})$ for all
$x \in \mathbb{Z}_pG$? The order of the two operations is immaterial, since $\hat\sigma$
permutes the units of $\mathbb{Z}_pG$.
-/
@[category research open, AMS 16 20]
theorem kourovka.«9.55» : answer(sorry) ↔
    ∃ (p : ℕ) (_ : Fact p.Prime) (G : Type) (_ : Group G) (_ : Finite G), IsPGroup p G ∧
      ∃ φ : MonoidAlgebra ℤ G ≃+* MonoidAlgebra ℤ G,
        IsAugmented φ ∧ IsCentral φ ∧ ¬ IsConjThenGroupInduced p (padicExtension p φ) := by
  sorry

end Kourovka.«9.55»

items: 'Central automorphism' is formalized as fixing the centre of ℤ[G] pointwise (Roggenkamp–Scott's usage; equivalent to fixing all class sums since they form a ℤ-basis of Z(ℤG)). It is stated on the centre rather than on class sums.
'Augmented' is formalized as ε ∘ φ = ε with ε the augmentation ℤ[G] → ℤ (sum of coefficients), via MonoidAlgebra.lift ℤ ℤ G 1.
φ is quantified as a ring automorphism `MonoidAlgebra ℤ G ≃+* MonoidAlgebra ℤ G`; ℤ-linearity is automatic, so this coincides with ℤ-algebra automorphisms.

The p-adic group ring is `MonoidAlgebra ℤ_[p] G` with ℤ_[p] = PadicInt p; the extension of φ is taken as a ℤ_[p]-algebra homomorphism (the unique ℤ_[p]-linear extension), constructed explicitly with MonoidAlgebra.lift and certified by the proven lemma padicExtension_toPadic rather than being quantified abstractly (avoids any vacuity concern).

The composition order is taken literally as 'conjugation by u followed by σ̂', i.e. ψ x = σ̂(u x u⁻¹); as the decomposition notes observe, the resulting class of maps is the same in either order since σ̂ permutes units.
The conjugating unit ranges over (ℤ_[p][G])ˣ, i.e. units of the p-adic group ring itself (not of ℚ_p[G]), as the statement requires.
The prime p is existentially quantified together with G (the statement's implicit quantifier over p), using `∃ (p : ℕ) (_ : Fact p.Prime)` since ℤ_[p] needs the Fact instance.

Status kept as `research open` with `answer(sorry)`, following the notebook. Reviewer note: Roggenkamp–Scott's 1987 Annals theorem on p-adic group rings of p-groups is widely understood to give a negative answer, but the notebook (v46) still lists the problem without a solved mark, so no answer was baked in.
G is quantified over `Type` (not `Type*`), following the convention of the other Kourovka files; every finite group is equivalent to one in Type.

reviewer_notes: Statement is a yes/no existence question; formalized as answer(sorry) ↔ ∃ p prime, ∃ finite p-group G, ∃ ring automorphism φ of ℤ[G], IsAugmented φ ∧ IsCentral φ ∧ ¬ IsConjThenGroupInduced p (padicExtension p φ). Interpretive choices (all shared by every candidate and by the decomposition notes): 'central automorphism' in the Roggenkamp–Scott/Hertweck sense (fixes Z(ℤG) elementwise, equivalently fixes class sums), not the group-theoretic notion; composition order of conjugation and σ̂ taken literally (σ̂ ∘ conj_u), immaterial since σ̂ permutes units; the conjugating unit lies in ℤ_[p][G] (PadicInt coefficients), not ℚ_p[G]. Reviewer note: Roggenkamp–Scott (Annals 1987) on p-adic group rings of p-groups is widely understood to give a negative answer, but the notebook (v46) still lists 9.55 without a solved mark, so the theorem is kept as `research open` with `answer(sorry)`.
